text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a High Wind Warning for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. No crashes nearby right now, but 3 construction zones could slow you down. It's 44°F, Cloudy, up to 45°.

weatherAlerts.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 25 at 1:56PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around or damaged by the wind. Remain in the lower levels of your home during the windstorm, and avoid windows. Watch for falling debris and tree limbs. Use caution if you must drive.
